verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe creating a flag from the dashboard (Features > Create Feature, with a name such as new_ui_enabled). The GitHub README says flags toggle on and off remotely without deploying new code, per environment, and the 15+ SDKs let a developer wrap code with the flag. Docs also describe a kill switch for quickly disabling a feature. missing for 10: no evidence of signup-to-first-toggle speed or a quickstart/onboarding flow (the 'within minutes' part), no independent or hands-on corroboration of the time-to-value.
